checklists.title: Scene Gizmo + Scene Authoring Current QA
checklists.description: Importable QA checklist generated after static auditing the current PungentFunkUtilities.zip. It focuses on the new Scene Authoring spatial primitives, the existing Scene Gizmo browser/source/provider systems, runtime query services, package registration, audit providers, UI reachability, and integration smoke tests.
checklists.defaultGuidance: Use Pass only when the feature is implemented in source, reachable in the active Unity UI, visible at practical window sizes, usable, and verified. Use Partial when the source exists but UI reachability, layout, or workflow polish remains. Use Fail for compile errors, broken call paths, hidden controls, or runtime/editor exceptions.

sections.title: Package Boundaries, Registration, and Menus
sections.guidancePrompt: Confirm the Scene Authoring package is treated as one unified package, while Core only owns shared contracts/fallbacks.

items.label: SceneAuthoring runtime asmdef exists and references Runtime only
items.detail: Verify `PungentFunk.Utilities.SceneAuthoring.Runtime.asmdef` exists, is runtime-safe, and does not reference `UnityEditor` or editor assemblies.

items.label: Editor asmdef references SceneAuthoring runtime
items.detail: Verify `PungentFunk.Utilities.Editor.asmdef` references `PungentFunk.Utilities.SceneAuthoring.Runtime` so editor tools can inspect spatial primitives.

items.label: Scene Authoring registrar is present
items.detail: Confirm `PungentSceneAuthoringRegistrar` initializes cleanly and owns Scene Authoring audit/provider registration.

items.label: Create Spatial Path Instance menu works
items.detail: Use GameObject > PungentFunk Utilities > Scene Tools > Create Spatial Path Instance and verify a selected object with `PungentPathInstance` is created at the selected object or SceneView pivot.

items.label: Create Spatial Area Instance menu works
items.detail: Use GameObject > PungentFunk Utilities > Scene Tools > Create Spatial Area Instance and verify a selected object with `PungentAreaInstance` is created at the selected object or SceneView pivot.

items.label: Tools menu creation paths work
items.detail: Use Tools > PungentFunk Utilities > Scene Tools creation entries and verify they call the same creation path as the GameObject menu.

items.label: Package catalog maps scene tools to Scene Authoring
items.detail: Check Utilities Browser/package metadata: scene gizmos, path authoring, placement, navigation, and spatial authoring should resolve to `com.pungentfunk.utilities.scene-authoring` rather than a separate scene-gizmos package.

items.label: Core hard references are identified or removed
items.detail: Search `PungentUtilityAccessMenus`, `PungentUtilityToolMenus`, and audit windows for direct scene-gizmo calls. Mark Partial if a migration path remains but hard references are still present.

sections.title: Spatial Foundation Runtime Models
sections.guidancePrompt: Validate the new runtime-safe spatial primitive layer for paths, areas, tags, layers, profiles, metadata, consumers, and query services.

items.label: Spatial profile enum includes expected roles
items.detail: Inspect `PungentSpatialProfile` and confirm it includes Generic, AIPath, CameraPath, EventSequencePath, PlacementPath, RoadPath, TerrainModifierPath, MapPath, RuntimeUIPath, PlacementArea, TerrainPaintArea, WeatherZone, TimeZone, SeasonZone, MapRegion, SpawnArea, TriggerArea, NavigationArea, AudioArea, LightingArea, GameplayRuleArea, and BiomeArea.

items.label: Spatial metadata creates stable IDs
items.detail: Add a path/area instance and confirm metadata gets a stable ID via default data/normalization without requiring manual entry.

items.label: Spatial metadata exposes authoring fields
items.detail: Verify metadata supports display name, description, profile, layer, tags, version, editor visibility, runtime enabled state, color, icon key, notes, and documentation links.

items.label: Tags and layers normalize safely
items.detail: Add tags/layers with whitespace or mixed case and confirm query/validation behavior treats them consistently.

items.label: Consumer and applier contracts compile
items.detail: Confirm `IPungentSpatialConsumer`, `IPungentPathConsumer`, `IPungentAreaConsumer`, `IPungentSpatialQueryProvider`, `IPungentSpatialApplier`, `IPungentSpatialPreviewProvider`, and `IPungentSpatialValidationProvider` compile and are runtime-safe.

items.label: Runtime foundation has no UnityEditor dependency
items.detail: Search `SceneAuthoring/Runtime` for `UnityEditor`; mark Fail if any runtime file directly imports editor APIs.

sections.title: Spatial Path Asset and Instance Tests
sections.guidancePrompt: Test `PungentPathAsset` and `PungentPathInstance` as reusable path primitives rather than one-off gizmo data.

items.label: Path instance creates default data
items.detail: Create a Spatial Path Instance and verify it has at least two default points after `EnsureDefaultData`/initial creation.

items.label: Path inspector exposes key serialized fields
items.detail: Select the path and verify asset reference, use-asset toggles, metadata, points, closed loop, directional mode, default corridor width, sampling, markers, and draw options are visible and editable.

items.label: Path profile can be assigned
items.detail: Set the path semantic profile to RoadPath, AIPath, PlacementPath, or CameraPath and verify it persists after selection/reload.

items.label: Normalized path sampling works
items.detail: Call or test `TrySamplePath(0.5f)` on a path with two or more points and verify it returns a midpoint sample with position, tangent, distance, normalized distance, and segment index.

items.label: Nearest path projection works
items.detail: Use `TryProjectPoint` or `PungentSpatialQueryService.GetNearestPathPoint` near the path and verify the result identifies the path and a plausible closest point.

items.label: Path width query works
items.detail: Set default corridor width and at least one override width, then verify `TryGetWidthAt`/`GetPathWidth` returns expected values.

items.label: Path bounds and visualization snapshot work
items.detail: Verify `TryGetSpatialBounds` and `TryGetSpatialVisualization` return usable bounds/draw metadata for the path.

items.label: Asset-backed path mode works
items.detail: Create or assign a `PungentPathAsset`, enable asset-backed points/metadata, and confirm instance queries use the asset values.

items.label: Path validation catches too few points
items.detail: Remove points until the path is invalid and verify validation/audit reports the path has too few points.

sections.title: Spatial Area Asset and Instance Tests
sections.guidancePrompt: Test `PungentAreaAsset` and `PungentAreaInstance` as reusable area/zone primitives.

items.label: Area instance creates default data
items.detail: Create a Spatial Area Instance and verify it has a valid default shape and metadata after creation.

items.label: Area inspector exposes key serialized fields
items.detail: Select the area and verify asset reference, use-asset toggles, metadata, shape, polygon points, rectangle/circle/box/sphere dimensions, vertical behavior, edge falloff, priority, runtime queryable, and draw options are visible/editable.

items.label: Polygon area shape works
items.detail: Use PolygonXZ mode, edit polygon points, and verify `TryGetAreaShape`, `GetWorldPolygon`, and bounds are plausible.

items.label: Rectangle and circle area modes work
items.detail: Switch between rectangle and circle modes and verify containment/bounds update correctly.

items.label: Box and sphere volume modes work
items.detail: Switch to box/sphere-style area primitives where available and verify volume/bounds/containment remain valid.

items.label: Vertical behavior is respected
items.detail: Test infinite, height-limited, terrain/projected, or object-space vertical behavior variants available in the current implementation and verify `ContainsWorldPoint` responds correctly.

items.label: Priority and layer affect query results
items.detail: Create overlapping areas on the same layer/profile with different priorities and verify highest-priority query returns the expected area.

items.label: Blend/falloff query produces weights
items.detail: Set edge falloff and query blend weights near center/edge/outside; verify weights are plausible and sorted by priority.

items.label: Asset-backed area mode works
items.detail: Create or assign a `PungentAreaAsset`, enable asset-backed shape/metadata, and confirm instance queries use asset values.

items.label: Area validation catches invalid shape
items.detail: Remove polygon points or create an invalid shape and verify validation/audit reports the issue.

sections.title: Runtime Query Service and Registry
sections.guidancePrompt: Exercise runtime-safe query APIs for finding paths/areas by position, priority, tag, stable ID, and sampling.

items.label: Spatial runtime registry discovers scene objects
items.detail: Add a `PungentSpatialRuntimeRegistry`, refresh/register scene paths and areas, and verify query service can find registered objects.

items.label: Get areas at position works
items.detail: Place a test object/point inside an area and verify `GetAreasAtPosition` returns that area.

items.label: Highest-priority area query works
items.detail: Create overlapping areas with different priorities and verify `GetHighestPriorityArea` returns the highest priority match for the requested layer/profile.

items.label: Area blend weights work
items.detail: Query `GetAreaBlendWeights` in overlapping or falloff regions and confirm weights, priorities, and layer/profile labels are populated.

items.label: Find paths and areas by tag works
items.detail: Add a shared tag to one path and one area, then verify `FindPathsByTag` and `FindAreasByTag` return the correct components.

items.label: Nearest path query works
items.detail: Place multiple paths and verify `GetNearestPathPoint` chooses the closest valid path.

items.label: Sample path by stable ID works
items.detail: Use a path stable ID with `SamplePathByDistance` and `SamplePathByNormalizedDistance`; verify both return valid samples.

items.label: Queries work in play mode
items.detail: Enter Play Mode and verify the registry/query service still returns runtime-enabled paths and areas without editor-only dependencies.

sections.title: Scene Gizmo Source Rule System
sections.guidancePrompt: Test the core `PungentSceneGizmoSource` visual-rule authoring workflow, presets, conditions, and binding behavior.

items.label: Add Scene Gizmo Source to selected object
items.detail: Use the utility/menu/browser action to add `PungentSceneGizmoSource` to a selected object and verify Undo removes it correctly.

items.label: Source inspector is usable
items.detail: Select an object with a gizmo source and verify the custom inspector exposes draw mode, rule list, presets/templates, validation/status, and open-browser actions without layout errors.

items.label: Rule shape types draw correctly
items.detail: Create rules for common shapes such as label, sphere/disc, bounds, ray/arrow, trigger/collider bounds, distance, and state label where supported; verify they draw in Scene View.

items.label: Position and size modes work
items.detail: Test transform, collider/bounds, field-bound, and offset-style position/size modes available in the inspector and verify scene output updates.

items.label: Condition modes work
items.detail: Set conditions based on always, selected-only, play/edit mode, field value, or component presence options available in the rule editor and verify visibility toggles as expected.

items.label: Reflected field bindings work or warn clearly
items.detail: Bind a rule to a valid component field/property and verify display updates; then enter an invalid path and verify the UI/status reports a warning instead of failing silently.

items.label: State color maps work
items.detail: Configure a state/value color map and verify the rule color changes when the bound value changes.

items.label: Built-in presets apply safely
items.detail: Apply built-in source presets/templates and verify rules are created or updated with Undo and without duplicate/stale data.

items.label: Invalid source rules are surfaced
items.detail: Create an intentionally invalid rule and verify the source inspector/browser/audit surfaces a useful warning.

sections.title: Scene Gizmo Provider Components
sections.guidancePrompt: Test beacon, collision sensor, trigger sensor, and trajectory visualizer components and their custom inspectors.

items.label: Beacon add and ping works
items.detail: Add `PungentSceneBeacon`, set label/color/radius, use ping if exposed, and verify ring/label/vertical line/distance settings draw correctly.

items.label: Beacon selected-only and always-visible modes work
items.detail: Toggle drawWhenSelectedOnly and alwaysVisible and verify scene visibility follows those settings.

items.label: Collision sensor records contacts
items.detail: Add `PungentCollisionSensorGizmo` to a collider object, enter Play Mode or simulate collision, and verify contact points/normals/history/clear controls work.

items.label: Trigger sensor records overlaps
items.detail: Add `PungentTriggerSensorGizmo` to a trigger collider, enter Play Mode, move another collider through it, and verify overlap links, labels, recent exits, and clear controls work.

items.label: Trajectory visualizer transform-forward mode works
items.detail: Add `PungentTrajectoryVisualizer`, use TransformForward mode, adjust speed/gravity/duration, and verify trajectory samples draw.

items.label: Trajectory visualizer Rigidbody mode works
items.detail: Assign a Rigidbody source and verify preview follows velocity when using Rigidbody source mode.

items.label: Trajectory visualizer reflected field mode works or warns
items.detail: Assign a reflected component and velocity field path; verify valid paths produce previews and invalid paths produce clear warnings.

items.label: Trajectory collision mode works
items.detail: Enable collision/sphere cast mode, aim at a collider, and verify hit marker and stop-at-first-hit behavior.

items.label: Provider custom inspectors remain usable
items.detail: Open each provider inspector and verify fields are grouped, clear history/refresh/open-browser controls work, and no GUILayout errors appear.

sections.title: Scene Gizmo Browser Window
sections.guidancePrompt: Test the browser as the management, design, preset, and performance surface for current scene gizmo systems.

items.label: Scene Gizmo Browser opens
items.detail: Open the Scene Gizmo Browser from the Utilities Browser/tools menu and verify it loads without exceptions.

items.label: Browser tabs are reachable
items.detail: Verify Overview, Design, Manage, Presets, and Performance tabs or their current equivalents are visible and usable at normal and narrow window widths.

items.label: Provider cache refreshes correctly
items.detail: Add/remove beacon, sensor, trajectory, and gizmo source components, refresh the browser, and verify counts and records update.

items.label: Browser filters work
items.detail: Test search, provider type filters, selected-only filters, preset state filters, and any active/inactive draw filters available in the toolbar.

items.label: Design workbench creates or edits rules
items.detail: Use the design/workbench area to add rules/templates/blocks to a selected source and verify the selected source updates.

items.label: Preset tab applies and diffs presets
items.detail: Apply built-in presets, inspect preset state/diff feedback, and verify changes are Undo-safe.

items.label: Manage tab batch actions work safely
items.detail: Use batch visibility/selected-only/enable-disable actions on test objects and verify Undo and target counts are correct.

items.label: Performance tab reports draw density
items.detail: Create several providers and verify performance summaries/draw cost warnings appear when thresholds are exceeded or when provider density is high.

items.label: Browser resizes without hiding controls
items.detail: Test narrow, medium, and wide sizes. Mark Partial if controls are technically present but cramped or require accidental layout expansion.

sections.title: Presets, Blocks, Commands, and Undo
sections.guidancePrompt: Validate reusable authoring helpers around presets, rule blocks, command services, and Undo behavior.

items.label: Built-in preset library is populated
items.detail: Verify `PungentSceneGizmoPresetLibrary` exposes useful built-in presets and the browser/inspector can list them.

items.label: Block library is populated
items.detail: Verify `PungentSceneGizmoBlockLibrary` exposes useful reusable blocks/templates and they appear in authoring UI.

items.label: Preset diff state is meaningful
items.detail: Modify a preset-applied source and verify diff state reports matching/modified/missing style states accurately.

items.label: Command service records Undo
items.detail: Apply presets/blocks/add-provider actions and confirm Ctrl+Z reverts scene/component changes cleanly.

items.label: Repeated preset application avoids bad duplicates
items.detail: Apply the same preset repeatedly and verify it updates or reports changes without creating confusing duplicate rule spam.

items.label: Add provider actions target selection correctly
items.detail: Select one or more objects and add beacon/collision/trigger/trajectory components; verify only intended objects receive components.

sections.title: Scene Authoring Integration Smoke Tests
sections.guidancePrompt: Exercise the first spatial primitive integrations with placement, environment, modular output, and legacy adapters.

items.label: Legacy area authoring shape still works
items.detail: Create/use `PungentAreaAuthoringShape` and verify it still exposes polygon/rectangle/circle modes, runtime query helpers, and gizmo visualization.

items.label: Existing path adapters still work
items.detail: Use current `PungentPathAuthoringAdapters` and `PungentSpatialRuntimeQueryUtility` against old and new path providers where compatible.

items.label: Modular spatial output can read a path source
items.detail: Assign a compatible path source to `PungentModularSpatialOutput`, preview/rebuild, and verify generated output follows the path.

items.label: Placement path integration still works
items.detail: Use the Asset Placement path integration utility/workflow to place assets along or around a path and verify generated objects align to tangent/surface settings.

items.label: Weather/time zone bridge is scaffolded or works
items.detail: Create an area with WeatherZone or TimeZone profile and verify environment/weather volume adapters either consume it or present a clear missing-bridge/scaffolded state.

items.label: Map region metadata is scaffolded or works
items.detail: Create an area with MapRegion profile and verify metadata/stable ID/color/label are enough for future map tooling, even if a map window is not implemented yet.

items.label: Runtime trigger area path is scaffolded or works
items.detail: Use a TriggerArea or SpawnArea profile and verify either collider/trigger generation exists or the UI makes the required manual binding clear.

sections.title: Audit, Validation, and Performance
sections.guidancePrompt: Run current scan providers and verify findings are useful, actionable, and not duplicated across old and new scene systems.

items.label: Scene Authoring audit provider registers
items.detail: Open Design Validation/scan provider UI if available and verify `PungentSceneAuthoringAuditProvider` appears or is included in scan results.

items.label: Scene Gizmo audit provider still registers
items.detail: Verify legacy/current Scene Gizmo audit provider still runs and does not conflict with the Scene Authoring provider.

items.label: Generic profile finding appears
items.detail: Leave a path/area on Generic profile and verify an informational finding recommends assigning a more specific profile.

items.label: Duplicate stable ID finding appears
items.detail: Duplicate a path/area with copied metadata and verify audit flags duplicate spatial stable IDs.

items.label: Broken reference finding appears
items.detail: Create missing/invalid object references in spatial/gizmo components and verify audit reports them.

items.label: Generated output stale warning appears
items.detail: Modify a source path/area after generating output and verify stale/may-be-stale output is reported where supported.

items.label: High draw density warning appears
items.detail: Create many providers or high point-count paths and verify draw density/performance warning appears in audit or browser.

items.label: No broad scan happens every repaint
items.detail: Profile or inspect behavior to ensure provider caches/scans are not rebuilt continuously during every `OnGUI`/Scene GUI repaint.

sections.title: UI Reachability and Regression Checks
sections.guidancePrompt: Confirm the new systems are not merely implemented in source but reachable, visible, usable, and stable in active Unity UI.

items.label: Utilities Browser scene entries open correct tools
items.detail: From Utilities Browser, open Scene Gizmo Browser, Path Authoring Toolkit, Spatial Authoring Toolkit, Placement Lab, and Scene Navigation where present; verify cards point to Scene Authoring package metadata.

items.label: Inspector open-browser handoffs work
items.detail: From gizmo/provider/spatial component inspectors, use Open Browser/Open Tool buttons and verify the relevant window opens with selection context where supported.

items.label: Scene View drawing updates live
items.detail: Toggle draw settings on paths, areas, gizmo sources, and providers and verify Scene View updates without requiring domain reload.

items.label: Play/Edit mode behavior is stable
items.detail: Enter and exit Play Mode with gizmo sources, providers, paths, areas, and runtime registry in the scene; verify no state loss or null-reference spam.

items.label: No GUILayout or repaint errors
items.detail: Use the browser, inspectors, provider components, and path/area tools for several minutes and verify no GUILayout mismatch, invalid layout state, or repaint exceptions appear.

items.label: Help/guidance is present where needed
items.detail: Verify tooltips/help boxes explain spatial profiles, asset-backed vs scene-local data, runtime queryability, draw options, and validation warnings.

linkedStateGroups.description: Search `PungentUtilityAccessMenus`, `PungentUtilityToolMenus`, and audit windows for direct scene-gizmo calls. Mark Partial if a migration path remains but hard references are still present.

linkedStateGroups.label: Spatial profile enum includes expected roles
linkedStateGroups.description: Inspect `PungentSpatialProfile` and confirm it includes Generic, AIPath, CameraPath, EventSequencePath, PlacementPath, RoadPath, TerrainModifierPath, MapPath, RuntimeUIPath, PlacementArea, TerrainPaintArea, WeatherZone, TimeZone, SeasonZone, MapRegion, SpawnArea, TriggerArea, NavigationArea, AudioArea, LightingArea, GameplayRuleArea, and BiomeArea.

linkedStateGroups.label: Spatial metadata creates stable IDs
linkedStateGroups.description: Add a path/area instance and confirm metadata gets a stable ID via default data/normalization without requiring manual entry.

linkedStateGroups.label: Spatial metadata exposes authoring fields
linkedStateGroups.description: Verify metadata supports display name, description, profile, layer, tags, version, editor visibility, runtime enabled state, color, icon key, notes, and documentation links.

linkedStateGroups.label: Tags and layers normalize safely
linkedStateGroups.description: Add tags/layers with whitespace or mixed case and confirm query/validation behavior treats them consistently.

linkedStateGroups.label: Consumer and applier contracts compile
linkedStateGroups.description: Confirm `IPungentSpatialConsumer`, `IPungentPathConsumer`, `IPungentAreaConsumer`, `IPungentSpatialQueryProvider`, `IPungentSpatialApplier`, `IPungentSpatialPreviewProvider`, and `IPungentSpatialValidationProvider` compile and are runtime-safe.

linkedStateGroups.label: Runtime foundation has no UnityEditor dependency
linkedStateGroups.description: Search `SceneAuthoring/Runtime` for `UnityEditor`; mark Fail if any runtime file directly imports editor APIs.

linkedStateGroups.label: Path instance creates default data
linkedStateGroups.description: Create a Spatial Path Instance and verify it has at least two default points after `EnsureDefaultData`/initial creation.

linkedStateGroups.label: Path inspector exposes key serialized fields
linkedStateGroups.description: Select the path and verify asset reference, use-asset toggles, metadata, points, closed loop, directional mode, default corridor width, sampling, markers, and draw options are visible and editable.

linkedStateGroups.label: Path profile can be assigned
linkedStateGroups.description: Set the path semantic profile to RoadPath, AIPath, PlacementPath, or CameraPath and verify it persists after selection/reload.

linkedStateGroups.label: Normalized path sampling works
linkedStateGroups.description: Call or test `TrySamplePath(0.5f)` on a path with two or more points and verify it returns a midpoint sample with position, tangent, distance, normalized distance, and segment index.

linkedStateGroups.label: Nearest path projection works
linkedStateGroups.description: Use `TryProjectPoint` or `PungentSpatialQueryService.GetNearestPathPoint` near the path and verify the result identifies the path and a plausible closest point.

linkedStateGroups.label: Path width query works
linkedStateGroups.description: Set default corridor width and at least one override width, then verify `TryGetWidthAt`/`GetPathWidth` returns expected values.

linkedStateGroups.label: Path bounds and visualization snapshot work
linkedStateGroups.description: Verify `TryGetSpatialBounds` and `TryGetSpatialVisualization` return usable bounds/draw metadata for the path.

linkedStateGroups.label: Asset-backed path mode works
linkedStateGroups.description: Create or assign a `PungentPathAsset`, enable asset-backed points/metadata, and confirm instance queries use the asset values.

linkedStateGroups.label: Path validation catches too few points
linkedStateGroups.description: Remove points until the path is invalid and verify validation/audit reports the path has too few points.

linkedStateGroups.label: Area instance creates default data
linkedStateGroups.description: Create a Spatial Area Instance and verify it has a valid default shape and metadata after creation.

linkedStateGroups.label: Area inspector exposes key serialized fields
linkedStateGroups.description: Select the area and verify asset reference, use-asset toggles, metadata, shape, polygon points, rectangle/circle/box/sphere dimensions, vertical behavior, edge falloff, priority, runtime queryable, and draw options are visible/editable.

linkedStateGroups.label: Polygon area shape works
linkedStateGroups.description: Use PolygonXZ mode, edit polygon points, and verify `TryGetAreaShape`, `GetWorldPolygon`, and bounds are plausible.

linkedStateGroups.label: Rectangle and circle area modes work
linkedStateGroups.description: Switch between rectangle and circle modes and verify containment/bounds update correctly.

linkedStateGroups.label: Box and sphere volume modes work
linkedStateGroups.description: Switch to box/sphere-style area primitives where available and verify volume/bounds/containment remain valid.

linkedStateGroups.label: Vertical behavior is respected
linkedStateGroups.description: Test infinite, height-limited, terrain/projected, or object-space vertical behavior variants available in the current implementation and verify `ContainsWorldPoint` responds correctly.

linkedStateGroups.label: Priority and layer affect query results
linkedStateGroups.description: Create overlapping areas on the same layer/profile with different priorities and verify highest-priority query returns the expected area.

linkedStateGroups.label: Blend/falloff query produces weights
linkedStateGroups.description: Set edge falloff and query blend weights near center/edge/outside; verify weights are plausible and sorted by priority.

linkedStateGroups.label: Asset-backed area mode works
linkedStateGroups.description: Create or assign a `PungentAreaAsset`, enable asset-backed shape/metadata, and confirm instance queries use asset values.

linkedStateGroups.label: Area validation catches invalid shape
linkedStateGroups.description: Remove polygon points or create an invalid shape and verify validation/audit reports the issue.

linkedStateGroups.label: Spatial runtime registry discovers scene objects
linkedStateGroups.description: Add a `PungentSpatialRuntimeRegistry`, refresh/register scene paths and areas, and verify query service can find registered objects.

linkedStateGroups.label: Get areas at position works
linkedStateGroups.description: Place a test object/point inside an area and verify `GetAreasAtPosition` returns that area.

linkedStateGroups.label: Highest-priority area query works
linkedStateGroups.description: Create overlapping areas with different priorities and verify `GetHighestPriorityArea` returns the highest priority match for the requested layer/profile.

linkedStateGroups.label: Area blend weights work
linkedStateGroups.description: Query `GetAreaBlendWeights` in overlapping or falloff regions and confirm weights, priorities, and layer/profile labels are populated.

linkedStateGroups.label: Find paths and areas by tag works
linkedStateGroups.description: Add a shared tag to one path and one area, then verify `FindPathsByTag` and `FindAreasByTag` return the correct components.

linkedStateGroups.label: Nearest path query works
linkedStateGroups.description: Place multiple paths and verify `GetNearestPathPoint` chooses the closest valid path.

linkedStateGroups.label: Sample path by stable ID works
linkedStateGroups.description: Use a path stable ID with `SamplePathByDistance` and `SamplePathByNormalizedDistance`; verify both return valid samples.

linkedStateGroups.label: Queries work in play mode
linkedStateGroups.description: Enter Play Mode and verify the registry/query service still returns runtime-enabled paths and areas without editor-only dependencies.

linkedStateGroups.label: Add Scene Gizmo Source to selected object
linkedStateGroups.description: Use the utility/menu/browser action to add `PungentSceneGizmoSource` to a selected object and verify Undo removes it correctly.

linkedStateGroups.label: Source inspector is usable
linkedStateGroups.description: Select an object with a gizmo source and verify the custom inspector exposes draw mode, rule list, presets/templates, validation/status, and open-browser actions without layout errors.

linkedStateGroups.label: Rule shape types draw correctly
linkedStateGroups.description: Create rules for common shapes such as label, sphere/disc, bounds, ray/arrow, trigger/collider bounds, distance, and state label where supported; verify they draw in Scene View.

linkedStateGroups.label: Position and size modes work
linkedStateGroups.description: Test transform, collider/bounds, field-bound, and offset-style position/size modes available in the inspector and verify scene output updates.

linkedStateGroups.label: Condition modes work
linkedStateGroups.description: Set conditions based on always, selected-only, play/edit mode, field value, or component presence options available in the rule editor and verify visibility toggles as expected.

linkedStateGroups.label: Reflected field bindings work or warn clearly
linkedStateGroups.description: Bind a rule to a valid component field/property and verify display updates; then enter an invalid path and verify the UI/status reports a warning instead of failing silently.

linkedStateGroups.label: State color maps work
linkedStateGroups.description: Configure a state/value color map and verify the rule color changes when the bound value changes.

linkedStateGroups.label: Built-in presets apply safely
linkedStateGroups.description: Apply built-in source presets/templates and verify rules are created or updated with Undo and without duplicate/stale data.

linkedStateGroups.label: Invalid source rules are surfaced
linkedStateGroups.description: Create an intentionally invalid rule and verify the source inspector/browser/audit surfaces a useful warning.

linkedStateGroups.label: Beacon add and ping works
linkedStateGroups.description: Add `PungentSceneBeacon`, set label/color/radius, use ping if exposed, and verify ring/label/vertical line/distance settings draw correctly.

linkedStateGroups.label: Beacon selected-only and always-visible modes work
linkedStateGroups.description: Toggle drawWhenSelectedOnly and alwaysVisible and verify scene visibility follows those settings.

linkedStateGroups.label: Collision sensor records contacts
linkedStateGroups.description: Add `PungentCollisionSensorGizmo` to a collider object, enter Play Mode or simulate collision, and verify contact points/normals/history/clear controls work.

linkedStateGroups.label: Trigger sensor records overlaps
linkedStateGroups.description: Add `PungentTriggerSensorGizmo` to a trigger collider, enter Play Mode, move another collider through it, and verify overlap links, labels, recent exits, and clear controls work.

linkedStateGroups.label: Trajectory visualizer transform-forward mode works
linkedStateGroups.description: Add `PungentTrajectoryVisualizer`, use TransformForward mode, adjust speed/gravity/duration, and verify trajectory samples draw.

linkedStateGroups.label: Trajectory visualizer Rigidbody mode works
linkedStateGroups.description: Assign a Rigidbody source and verify preview follows velocity when using Rigidbody source mode.

linkedStateGroups.label: Trajectory visualizer reflected field mode works or warns
linkedStateGroups.description: Assign a reflected component and velocity field path; verify valid paths produce previews and invalid paths produce clear warnings.

linkedStateGroups.label: Trajectory collision mode works
linkedStateGroups.description: Enable collision/sphere cast mode, aim at a collider, and verify hit marker and stop-at-first-hit behavior.

linkedStateGroups.label: Provider custom inspectors remain usable
linkedStateGroups.description: Open each provider inspector and verify fields are grouped, clear history/refresh/open-browser controls work, and no GUILayout errors appear.

linkedStateGroups.label: Scene Gizmo Browser opens
linkedStateGroups.description: Open the Scene Gizmo Browser from the Utilities Browser/tools menu and verify it loads without exceptions.

linkedStateGroups.label: Browser tabs are reachable
linkedStateGroups.description: Verify Overview, Design, Manage, Presets, and Performance tabs or their current equivalents are visible and usable at normal and narrow window widths.

linkedStateGroups.label: Provider cache refreshes correctly
linkedStateGroups.description: Add/remove beacon, sensor, trajectory, and gizmo source components, refresh the browser, and verify counts and records update.

linkedStateGroups.label: Browser filters work
linkedStateGroups.description: Test search, provider type filters, selected-only filters, preset state filters, and any active/inactive draw filters available in the toolbar.

linkedStateGroups.label: Design workbench creates or edits rules
linkedStateGroups.description: Use the design/workbench area to add rules/templates/blocks to a selected source and verify the selected source updates.

linkedStateGroups.label: Preset tab applies and diffs presets
linkedStateGroups.description: Apply built-in presets, inspect preset state/diff feedback, and verify changes are Undo-safe.

linkedStateGroups.label: Manage tab batch actions work safely
linkedStateGroups.description: Use batch visibility/selected-only/enable-disable actions on test objects and verify Undo and target counts are correct.

linkedStateGroups.label: Performance tab reports draw density
linkedStateGroups.description: Create several providers and verify performance summaries/draw cost warnings appear when thresholds are exceeded or when provider density is high.

linkedStateGroups.label: Browser resizes without hiding controls
linkedStateGroups.description: Test narrow, medium, and wide sizes. Mark Partial if controls are technically present but cramped or require accidental layout expansion.

linkedStateGroups.label: Built-in preset library is populated
linkedStateGroups.description: Verify `PungentSceneGizmoPresetLibrary` exposes useful built-in presets and the browser/inspector can list them.

linkedStateGroups.label: Block library is populated
linkedStateGroups.description: Verify `PungentSceneGizmoBlockLibrary` exposes useful reusable blocks/templates and they appear in authoring UI.

linkedStateGroups.label: Preset diff state is meaningful
linkedStateGroups.description: Modify a preset-applied source and verify diff state reports matching/modified/missing style states accurately.

linkedStateGroups.label: Command service records Undo
linkedStateGroups.description: Apply presets/blocks/add-provider actions and confirm Ctrl+Z reverts scene/component changes cleanly.

linkedStateGroups.label: Repeated preset application avoids bad duplicates
linkedStateGroups.description: Apply the same preset repeatedly and verify it updates or reports changes without creating confusing duplicate rule spam.

linkedStateGroups.label: Add provider actions target selection correctly
linkedStateGroups.description: Select one or more objects and add beacon/collision/trigger/trajectory components; verify only intended objects receive components.

linkedStateGroups.label: Legacy area authoring shape still works
linkedStateGroups.description: Create/use `PungentAreaAuthoringShape` and verify it still exposes polygon/rectangle/circle modes, runtime query helpers, and gizmo visualization.

linkedStateGroups.label: Existing path adapters still work
linkedStateGroups.description: Use current `PungentPathAuthoringAdapters` and `PungentSpatialRuntimeQueryUtility` against old and new path providers where compatible.

linkedStateGroups.label: Modular spatial output can read a path source
linkedStateGroups.description: Assign a compatible path source to `PungentModularSpatialOutput`, preview/rebuild, and verify generated output follows the path.

linkedStateGroups.label: Placement path integration still works
linkedStateGroups.description: Use the Asset Placement path integration utility/workflow to place assets along or around a path and verify generated objects align to tangent/surface settings.

linkedStateGroups.label: Weather/time zone bridge is scaffolded or works
linkedStateGroups.description: Create an area with WeatherZone or TimeZone profile and verify environment/weather volume adapters either consume it or present a clear missing-bridge/scaffolded state.

linkedStateGroups.label: Map region metadata is scaffolded or works
linkedStateGroups.description: Create an area with MapRegion profile and verify metadata/stable ID/color/label are enough for future map tooling, even if a map window is not implemented yet.

linkedStateGroups.label: Runtime trigger area path is scaffolded or works
linkedStateGroups.description: Use a TriggerArea or SpawnArea profile and verify either collider/trigger generation exists or the UI makes the required manual binding clear.

linkedStateGroups.label: Scene Authoring audit provider registers
linkedStateGroups.description: Open Design Validation/scan provider UI if available and verify `PungentSceneAuthoringAuditProvider` appears or is included in scan results.

linkedStateGroups.label: Scene Gizmo audit provider still registers
linkedStateGroups.description: Verify legacy/current Scene Gizmo audit provider still runs and does not conflict with the Scene Authoring provider.

linkedStateGroups.label: Generic profile finding appears
linkedStateGroups.description: Leave a path/area on Generic profile and verify an informational finding recommends assigning a more specific profile.

linkedStateGroups.label: Duplicate stable ID finding appears
linkedStateGroups.description: Duplicate a path/area with copied metadata and verify audit flags duplicate spatial stable IDs.

linkedStateGroups.label: Broken reference finding appears
linkedStateGroups.description: Create missing/invalid object references in spatial/gizmo components and verify audit reports them.

linkedStateGroups.label: Generated output stale warning appears
linkedStateGroups.description: Modify a source path/area after generating output and verify stale/may-be-stale output is reported where supported.

linkedStateGroups.label: High draw density warning appears
linkedStateGroups.description: Create many providers or high point-count paths and verify draw density/performance warning appears in audit or browser.

linkedStateGroups.label: No broad scan happens every repaint
linkedStateGroups.description: Profile or inspect behavior to ensure provider caches/scans are not rebuilt continuously during every `OnGUI`/Scene GUI repaint.

linkedStateGroups.label: Utilities Browser scene entries open correct tools
linkedStateGroups.description: From Utilities Browser, open Scene Gizmo Browser, Path Authoring Toolkit, Spatial Authoring Toolkit, Placement Lab, and Scene Navigation where present; verify cards point to Scene Authoring package metadata.

linkedStateGroups.label: Inspector open-browser handoffs work
linkedStateGroups.description: From gizmo/provider/spatial component inspectors, use Open Browser/Open Tool buttons and verify the relevant window opens with selection context where supported.

linkedStateGroups.label: Scene View drawing updates live
linkedStateGroups.description: Toggle draw settings on paths, areas, gizmo sources, and providers and verify Scene View updates without requiring domain reload.

linkedStateGroups.label: Play/Edit mode behavior is stable
linkedStateGroups.description: Enter and exit Play Mode with gizmo sources, providers, paths, areas, and runtime registry in the scene; verify no state loss or null-reference spam.

linkedStateGroups.label: No GUILayout or repaint errors
linkedStateGroups.description: Use the browser, inspectors, provider components, and path/area tools for several minutes and verify no GUILayout mismatch, invalid layout state, or repaint exceptions appear.

linkedStateGroups.label: Help/guidance is present where needed
linkedStateGroups.description: Verify tooltips/help boxes explain spatial profiles, asset-backed vs scene-local data, runtime queryability, draw options, and validation warnings.
